$comment: Reconciliation record for the curated gallery photographs. This file is
documentation, not runtime: nothing in the application reads it. The runtime
manifest is src/lib/gallery-images.ts, which this file was reconciled against.
Reconciled against the files actually present in public/images/gallery/.
The previous manifest was stale: it described eight WebP derivatives that no
longer exist, declared dimensions that matched no file, and referenced a
wooden-ship image that is not in the repository at all.
generatedFrom: inspection of public/images/gallery/ on phase-2 review

published.note: The one 16:9 source. Cropped to 4:3 by the processing script. CONTENT_POLICY.md allows cropping; nothing is stretched.

rejected.reason: Shares a base name with the published dining-room image but is a DIFFERENT photograph, not a duplicate.
evidence: Decoded pixels differ by a mean absolute channel difference of 70.4/255, which is a different picture rather than a re-encode.
It is the only file in the set carrying an EXIF block, so it entered the folder by a different route.
The previously approved derivative was 804x603, a 4:3 ratio, which matches the PNG and not this JPEG.
rejected.decision: Kept on disk, referenced by nothing. Deleting it needs owner approval, so it has not been deleted.
rejected.ownerAction: Confirm whether this is a second dining-room view worth publishing. If so, add it to src/lib/gallery-images.ts under its own slug; if not, delete it.

missing.reason: The previous manifest published wooden-ship-decor.webp as 'Décoration maritime avec bateau en bois'. No such file exists in any form in the repository.
missing.decision: The reference is removed rather than left pointing at a missing file. Nothing renders it.

authenticity.confirmedBy: Restaurant owner, stated directly and recorded here in phase 3.
authenticity.ownerStatement: The gallery photographs are from the restaurant. They were edited only for lighting; the portions and the scene content were not changed.
authenticity.recordedAs: provenance 'owner-confirmed' on every published entry, with the lighting edit disclosed on /galerie.
whatThisIsNot: Not an independent visual review. Nobody working on this repository compared the files against the restaurant to confirm they are photographs of it, and the files still carry no EXIF text or ICC profile to corroborate them.
Not a provenance chain. The repository cannot say who took the photographs or with what device.
Not a statement about the 16:9 starters-and-salads source beyond the owner's statement. It is cropped to 4:3 by the processing script, which is a framing change and is disclosed separately below.

separateConsentGap.gap: No consent record exists for people who may appear in the photographs, such as staff or customers.
separateConsentGap.whyItIsSeparate: The owner confirming that a photograph is of the restaurant says nothing about whether identifiable individuals agreed to be published. The two questions need separate answers.
separateConsentGap.ownerAction: Confirm whether any identifiable person appears, and obtain and record their agreement before launch. Kept in docs/FINAL_REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md until then.

authenticity.policy: docs/CONTENT_POLICY.md ranks an owner-approved temporary AI image fifth and below it only 'no image', and forbids passing materially different work off as documentary. A lighting adjustment is disclosed rather than passed off as untouched.
authenticity.notClaimedByThisRepository: Nothing here asserts a species, a certification, a camera provenance, or that any photograph shows a dish actually served.
